title: Document and pin fatal checkpoint write-cut refusal when a transcript row is isolated
outcome: The session-isolation contract explicitly preserves fatal checkpoint mirror and ledger validation and a regression pins their combined boundary.
acceptance: A disposable regression combines a rejected transcript row retaining its last-good checkpoint mirror with changed global ledger data and proves the incoherent full cut is refused atomically.
Documentation states this boundary without promising every sibling write succeeds across a fatal ledger or mirror refusal; no checkpoint authority or integrity validation is weakened.
